stream_id_allocations.security_classification: Secure Exclave Isolated / Host AP Prohibited

stream_id_allocations.content_type: Pointer cursor raster overlay (AssistiveTouch, Stage Manager cursor)

hardware_blending_engine.composition_mode: Zero-DRAM Writeback Real-Time Scanout Alpha Blending

z_order_hierarchy.name: Exclave Secure Overlay Plane (SIL, Apple Pay, Face ID)

hardware_blending_engine.host_isolation_guarantee: Exclave plane scanout lines are blended directly in the scanout FIFO without buffering back into system memory. Host CPU, GPU, and DART-DISP0 DMA engines have no address translation entries or bus route to read composited pixels or Stream ID 0x02 source buffers.

secure_indicator_light_protection.nits_capping_enforcement: SecureBlendHandler checks indicator luminance against panel maximum; triggers 'IOMFB: Secure indicator nits (0x%x) above Indicator nits cap (0x%x)' if request exceeds hardware limit.
secure_indicator_light_protection.anti_spoofing: Host planes cannot occlude layer 2 pixels. Any host pixel mapped to the SIL bounding box is overridden with hardware alpha clamp.
